weakness: SYS-01 administrator (irrigation control) and booking admin accounts have no MFA
remediation_plan: Turn on authenticator-app MFA on both; store recovery codes in the sealed envelope (POL-01 7.6)
milestones: 2026-09-15 MFA on and tested on both accounts

weakness: Default passwords on the router and pump controller; one password reused on SYS-01 and booking; all passwords saved in the shared laptop browser; no compromise steps
source: P07 assessment (IA-05 objectives, new finding IA-05e.); P03 PR.AA-01
remediation_plan: Password manager with unique passphrases; clear the browser store; change the router password now and the pump controller password with the dealer; one-page lost-phone and compromise steps
milestones: 2026-09-15 password manager in use and router changed; 2026-09-15 pump controller changed at dealer visit
resources_required: Password manager about $40 a year; dealer visit about $150

weakness: Dealer has always-on remote control of the pump and pivot through SYS-01; vendor support access always on; no usage rules
remediation_plan: Dealer account to viewer role; owner opens service windows for named jobs; support access on only for a support case; dealer security terms at renewal (POL-01 6.3)
milestones: 2026-09-30 viewer role and support access off; 2026-12-31 terms in the renewed agreement

weakness: Customer Wi-Fi, laptop, and pump controller share one flat network; no monitoring
remediation_plan: Turn on guest isolation for customer Wi-Fi now; give the pump house its own network on a router that supports it; turn on router logging
milestones: 2026-09-15 guest isolation on and retested; 2026-11-15 pump house network separated
resources_required: New router about $200 if the provider's cannot separate networks; IT technician 2 hours

weakness: No farm-held backups; records and security documents without version history
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a. and CP-09c.); P03 PR.DS-11; 21 CFR 112.7(b)
remediation_plan: Business file plan with version history; encrypted backup drive; monthly exports of SYS-01, booking sales, and accounting reports; quarterly restore test (POL-01 8.4)
milestones: 2026-10-05 first monthly export; 2026-10-31 file plan and backup drive in use; 2027-01-04 first restore test
resources_required: File plan about $150 a year; backup drive about $100

weakness: No vendor list or security terms; AI vendor may use farm data; no breach contacts registered
remediation_plan: Vendor list (POL-01 Appendix A); register the farm breach contact with booking and accounting vendors; AI vendor opt-out or stop (P10); dealer terms (POAM-003)
milestones: 2026-09-30 vendor list and contacts; 2026-10-31 AI decision; 2026-12-31 dealer terms

weakness: No incident reporting time or notification contact list
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 Fla. Stat. 501.171(4)
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; print contacts for the home office and pump house; mail rule to flag vendor security notices
milestones: 2026-08-31 runbook adopted; 2026-09-30 contacts printed and mail rule set

weakness: No review or update cycle for the risk assessment
remediation_plan: POL-01 4.3 sets a July review and change triggers; first update July 2027
